# @tjcages/panels

> Floating React control panel for any live state. One hook (`usePanel`). Compiles out of production. Toggle ⌘⌥D / Ctrl+Alt+D.

Install: `npm install @tjcages/panels`. Install prompt: `SETUP_PROMPT.md`. Agent brief: `AGENT.md` / https://offbr.co/tools/panels/installation. Docs: https://offbr.co/tools/panels/docs/. Full catalog: `AGENTS.md`. Skill: `skills/panels/SKILL.md`.

Do not invent APIs. No `type: "text"` field. Prefer `registerPanel*` capture names; `registerShader*` aliases remain.

## usePanel

```ts
import { usePanel, type PanelField } from "@tjcages/panels"
const [config, setConfig] = usePanel({
  id, title, defaults, fields?,  // omit/[] infers from defaults; explicit wins
  persist?,          // default true
  scrollTo?,         // CSS selector; header switcher scrolls here
  onSelect?,         // () => void — TARGET navigation, not collection select
  autoMount?,        // default true — do not wrap production UI
})
```

Also: `side?: "left"|"right"`, `prompts?` (default `[]`), `actionHandlers?`, `onWriteConfig?`, `defaultTheme?`, `defaultOpen?`.

Shaders: `useShaderPanel` from `@tjcages/panels/shader` (same opts, prompt rail on).

## Field types (`PanelField<T>`)

| type | value | when |
|---|---|---|
| `section` | — | group; `{ title }`; no key |
| `slider` | `number` | `{ key, label, min, max, step }` |
| `color` | hex string | `{ key, label, library?, persist? }` |
| `toggle` | `boolean` | `{ key, label }` |
| `toggle-group` | string\|number | segmented `{ key, label, options }` |
| `select` | string\|number | dropdown `{ key, label, options }` |
| `vec2` | `[x,y]` | `{ key, label, min, max, step }` |
| `image` | URL string | never persisted |
| `path` | `[x,y][]` | `{ key, label, min, max, anchorKey? }` |
| `gradient-stops` | `GradientStop[]` | `{ key, label, layout?: "field"|"ramp" }` |
| `stripe-table` | `EditableStripe[]` | `{ key, label, options? }` |
| `action` | — | `{ actionId, label }` + `actionHandlers` |
| `presets` | — | `{ presets: [{ label, values? }] }` |
| `collection` | `Item[]` (`id: string`) | managed list; nest `itemFields` |
| `reference` | `string` \| `string[]` | `{ key, label, collection, multiple? }` |

## Composition

- Sections group; nest the same union in `itemFields` (array or `(item, i) => fields`).
- `reference` reads sibling collections from **root** state.
- Prefer explicit `fields`. Omit/`[]` infers number/hex/boolean/vec2/`{id}[]`; skips nested objects and plain strings.
- One `usePanel` per target. Switcher appears at 2+. `scrollTo` then `onSelect()`.
- Do not wrap production UI in `ToolShell`/`PanelRoot`. Import `@tjcages/panels`, not `/dev`.
- Adapters skip `section`/`action`/`presets`. Do not put collection/reference/image/path/gradient-stops/stripe-table through them.

## Collections

```ts
{ type: "collection", key, label,
  itemFields, itemLabel?, newItem?, addLabel?, min?, max?,
  reorderable?, multiOpen?, migrate? }
{ type: "reference", key, label, collection, multiple?, optionLabel?, placeholder? }
```

Open disclosure = selection. `usePanel.onSelect` is target nav, not row select. Two-way bind: `selectPanelCollectionItem(panelId, collectionKey, id)` or `<PanelOverlay panelId collectionKey itemId>`. `Panel.onSelect(collectionKey, id)` exists for manual `<Panel/>` only; auto-mount does not wire it.

## Overlay / drag / clock (OFF-138/139/140 shipped)

`@tjcages/panels`: `createOverlayProjector(binding, { container? })` → `{ register, destroy }`.
Binding: `project(Vec3)`, `onFrame`, optional `unproject`.
Clock: `usePanelFrame(({ time, delta }) => { … })` — delta is 0 while paused.

`@tjcages/panels/shader` (inside R3F `<Canvas>`):
```tsx
<PanelClock />
<PanelOverlay anchor={object3D | [x,y,z]} panelId collectionKey itemId>
  <Pin />
</PanelOverlay>
const drag = useDragHandle({ anchor, onDrag, surface? })
<div {...drag.handleProps} />
```

## Capture

From `@tjcages/panels`; `register*` returns unsubscribe. Prefer `registerPanel*` (`registerShader*` aliases remain):

- `registerPanelCapture(({ maxEdge }) => Promise<Blob>)`
- `registerPanelGifExport(({ durationSec, fps, maxEdge, onProgress? }) => Promise<Blob>)`
- `registerPanelVideoExport(() => Promise<{ stop(): Promise<Blob> }>)`
- `registerPanelRecordCanvas(() => HTMLCanvasElement | null)`
- `registerPanelRecordPrepare(() => Promise<void>)`
- `registerPanelRecordFrame(() => void | Promise<void>)`
- `compositeCaptureFrame({ layers, maxEdge? })` — canvas/ImageBitmap layers, bottom→top

No registrant → largest page `<canvas>` at screen res.

## Shader adapters (`@tjcages/panels/shader`)

`createWebGLAdapter({ fields, mapping?, prefix?, colorAs?, toggleAs? })`
`createR3FAdapter({ uniforms, fields, mapping?, prefix? })`
Also `hexToRgb01`, `patchShaderConfigDefaults`. Stay live in production.

## Production

`production` condition → ~5 KB no-op. `usePanel` returns defaults. Adapters work. Overlay/drag/capture/UI stub. Force UI: `@tjcages/panels/dev`.
